name: blockchain-network
description: Blockchain network with ERC-20 nodes across multiple chains

scripts.anvil: npm run open:anvils && sleep 3 && npm run test
scripts.open:anvils: gnome-terminal --title='1111' -- bash -c 'npm run anvil:node1; exec bash' & gnome-terminal --title='2222' -- bash -c 'npm run anvil:node2; exec bash'
scripts.hardhat: npm run open:hardhats && sleep 3 && npm run test
scripts.open:hardhats: gnome-terminal -- bash -c 'npm run hardhat:node1; exec bash' & gnome-terminal -- bash -c 'npm run hardhat:node2; exec bash'
